facts: Use the official OpenSearch Java client already named by the approved OpenSearchClient seam; pom.xml currently has no production dependency, so feat-004 owns adding it without changing the Java 21 build contract.

OpenSearchLogIndexBootstrap.ensureInstalled(OpenSearchClient, OpenSearchLogIndexConfig) validates indexPrefix as exactly log-debug-v1 and returns RetentionInstallation(policyId, templateName, activeIndex).

The fixed resources are policy log-debug-retention-v1, template log-debug-v1-template, and the injected Clock's UTC index log-debug-v1-YYYY.MM.dd; canonical definitions belong under service/src/main/resources/opensearch.

The policy uses ism_template pattern log-debug-v1-* at priority 100 and reaches a delete action after min_index_age 7d; the template uses the same pattern/priority and installs the approved v1 mappings before any document write.

Bootstrap reconciles only the exact named policy and template, treats an already-existing daily index as success only after rereading and verifying that exact index, returns only after all three resources are observable, never deletes resources, and never closes the caller-owned client.

OpenSearchLogIndex remains the data-plane IndexPort seam and receives RetentionInstallation.activeIndex(); its typed query behavior and field round trip remain the same claim already described by INV-META-1 and INV-CORR-1.

feat-004 owns implementation and adapter-level tests. feat-005 owns the independent authorized-real-store oracle; MCP, collector, chart permissions, and the Kubernetes journey remain outside this feature.
